_about: Own-origin gzip KB per request body (level 9), cache off, mobile viewport, 3.5 s settle, measured 7 Oct 2026 against a production build + seeded local stack (run twice, within 1 KB). Budget = measured +5 % rounded up (requests +3). See e2e/route-payload-budget.spec.ts; change a budget on purpose in the same PR. PWA (PR #960, 18 Oct 2026): every route's request budget is +2, for exactly two named requests the installable-app work adds to every page and nothing else: GET /sw.js (the service worker script, fetched when the page registers it after load and idle) and GET /offline (the worker's install-time fetch of its offline page). Measured per route, names only, clean main vs the branch on the same stack: each route had exactly these two added and no other difference (chunk hashes aside). Bytes did not change enough to move any KB budget.
